facts.rubric: Located R-53001 using immutable identifiers and preserved effective standard v5: resource code grid-config resolves to RES-GRID-CFG; grid-dispatch (RES-GRID-DISP) is a different console and domain.
facts.statement: AGR-0003: resource code grid-config resolves to RES-GRID-CFG; grid-dispatch (RES-GRID-DISP) is a different console and domain; the effective standard is v5.

facts.rubric: Applied the operative clause and the request batch to establish 6 REVIEW_HOUR for review hours for one continuous grid-config cohort review (two 3-hour review windows), with control date 2026-05-15.
facts.statement: The operative clause and the request batch establish review hours for one continuous grid-config cohort review (two 3-hour review windows) = 6 REVIEW_HOUR: the continuous high-sensitivity review needs two review windows (6 review hours) on one tier-1-capable approver-day. The control date is 2026-05-15 (the substation maintenance freeze begins 2026-05-16, so the config review must complete by 2026-05-15).

facts.rubric: Reconciled 24 observed less 21 excluded to 3 eligible REVIEW_HOUR for review hours free on tier-1-capable approvers inside the requested 2026-05-12 window.
facts.statement: three requesters are attested; the dispatch holder is refused and the relay resubmission is a duplicate; eligibility requires netting the blocked and duplicate requests rather than trusting the raw queue.

facts.rubric: Used the independently confirmed 2026-05-12 expedited screening readiness for displace_protected_freeze, then separately derived its 2026-05-12 operating outcome under one continuous review session on a tier-1-capable approver without displacing protected windows instead of treating a vendor promise as authorization or a completion date.
facts.statement: Sentinel's confirmed standard and expedited attestation-refresh dates on RQ-53001: Sentinel RQ-53001 confirms attestation refresh standard 2026-05-13 and expedited 2026-05-11 (+USD 240); the cohort itself is attested; a vendor confirmation alone proves neither eligibility nor approval.

facts.rubric: Applied free full-day approver windows on a tier-1-capable approver to derive the three option outcomes without using protected or blocked review windows.
facts.statement: free full-day approver windows on a tier-1-capable approver: on 2026-05-12 the two tier-1-capable approvers offer 24 review hours gross; both morning windows are the protected freeze and only one afternoon window is free, leaving 3 usable hours, 3 short of the 6 required; protected and blocked review windows cannot be displaced.

facts.rubric: Applied AP-AG-0103 only to review_first_full_free_day and R-53001; kept displace_protected_freeze outside current authority.
facts.statement: AP-AG-0103 authorises the review on a tier-1-capable approver; displacing a protected freeze needs the risk committee and splitting the review is prohibited. The approval does not select an option in advance and does not authorize displace_protected_freeze.

facts.rubric: Compared all three alternatives and selected review_first_full_free_day: it is the best currently authorized disposition that satisfies one continuous review session on a tier-1-capable approver without displacing protected windows.
facts.statement: the maintenance freeze begins 2026-05-16, so the review must complete by 2026-05-15; a faster or broader disposition has value only if it stays inside one continuous review session on a tier-1-capable approver without displacing protected windows.

options.consequence: review first full free day books the high-sensitivity config cohort review into APR-2's free AM and PM windows on 2026-05-14, keeps it one continuous session, and lands before the maintenance freeze, at no incremental cost.
options.label: review_first_full_free_day: outcome 2026-05-14, incremental cost USD 0, SUPPORTED_AND_APPROVED

options.consequence: displace the protected freeze would fit the review on the requested 2026-05-12 by reusing a protected morning block, two days earlier, but displacing a protected window needs the risk committee chair, which AP-AG-0103 does not carry.
options.label: displace_protected_freeze: outcome 2026-05-12, incremental cost USD 0, SEPARATE_APPROVAL_OR_POLICY_EXCEPTION_REQUIRED

options.consequence: split the review across days would use the single free 2026-05-12 PM window plus a second day, but the standard requires one continuous review session, so the evidence does not support it.
options.label: split_review_across_days: outcome 2026-05-13, incremental cost USD 0, FAILS_CURRENT_CONTROL
